title: MoQT Test Vector Version Metadata
description: Per-version metadata for a specification draft or stable release.

id.description: Must match the directory name and the manifest entry.

categories.description: Which subdirectories exist. codec: wire encoding of transport messages (codec-vector.schema.json). catalog: MSF and CMSF catalog objects and their deltas (catalog-vector.schema.json). properties and timeline are reserved for property values and timeline track payloads and name no directory yet.

id.description: A version id of that spec.

requires.description: The version of another spec in this corpus that this one extends, as the draft's own references name it - CMSF-01 extends MSF-01. Absent when the draft extends nothing, or extends a document this corpus does not carry; `description` then says which.

description.description: Free-form notes on the version: what it extends, and anything about its text a consumer should know before running its vectors.
